02.
1. The bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Kodala P.S.
Case No. 275 of 2019 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 132/2019 and T.R. No. 108/2022 (FTSC)
pending in the Court of the learned Ad hoc Additional District & Sessions Judge (FTSC) under POCSO Act, Berhampur, Ganjam under Sections 363, 376 (AB), 506 of IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act.
2. The I.A. has been filed for releasing the petitioner on interim bail for a period of one month as his father-Banka Sahu has expired on 07.11.2023 and as the petitioner is the only son, his release is necessary to perform the obsequies of his father.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: As the petitioner is accused of committing offences under Sections 363, 376 (AB), 506 of IPC read with Section 4 of POCSO Act and is not the only son of late Banka Sahu, I am not inclined to release him on interim bail to perform the obsequies of his father.
